newsitem.title: USA: Heftel files for 3.5 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Heftel files for 3.5 million shares.

text.p: Heftel Broadcasting Corp said Wednesday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 3.5 million Class A common shares.
After the offering, the company will have 15,047,731 shares of Class A common outstanding, the filing said.

Net proceeds will be used to reduce borrowing under the credit agreement. Such funds may be subsequently re-borrowed for general corporate purposes, including working capital and possible acquisitions of radio stations, the filing said.

The company granted the underwriters an over-allotment option to buy up to 525,000 additional shares. The offering will be made through Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, CS First Boston, Lehman Brothers, Montgomery Securities, Smith Barney Inc.
The Spanish language radio broadcasting company is based in San Antonio, Texas.
